versions.subject: Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetObject|startswith:
        - 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\SystemRestore'
        - 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\SystemRestore'
    TargetObject|endswith: 
        - DisableConfig
        - DisableSR
    Details: 'DWORD (0x00000001)'
condition: selection
versions.spl: TargetObject IN ("HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\SystemRestore*", "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\SystemRestore*") TargetObject IN ("*DisableConfig", "*DisableSR") Details="DWORD (0x00000001)"
